limitations: Current authenticated no-KB service cohort is only 574/11756 = 4.8826%, versus planned retrieval 6860/11756 = 58.3532% and preauth robustness 4322/11756 = 36.7642%. Aggregate gains may not reflect the currently deployed backend; require separate current-service gates and report raw denominators.
Current-service training action counts include only human44/refuse31/close25/redirect30 and no retrieve by capability design. Do not infer reliable real-traffic safety from aggregate sample size.
Tokenizer evidence verifies formatting, candidate tokens and context budget only. It provides no model-quality, GPU memory or training-duration estimate.
The study is a design freeze with training_enabled=false. New executor, crash-safe checkpoints, pause/resume and single-GPU ownership still require implementation and independent review.
Tool objective is intentionally additional supervision; do not describe the loss as equal weight per original row. Executor must use the stated formula and actual partial-batch count.

No evaluation examples or model-score files were opened by this reviewer. Only permitted tokenizer aggregate statistics and training summary were read. Existing nine CPU tests were not rerun because their sources were unchanged.
The small synthetic development/calibration/final groups require denominators, intervals and group-aware uncertainty; passing gates is not a deployment certification.
